description: This file defines the SectionMask class, which manages a bitmask representing different sections (Event, POJO, Message) for a wrapper. It provides methods for adding sections and checking if a section is present.

classes.name: SectionMask
classes.description: A class that manages a bitmask indicating inclusion in different sections (Event, POJO, Message) with methods to add sections and check their presence.

methods.name: SectionMask
methods.description: Constructor initializing the bitmask to zero.

methods.name: addEventSection
methods.description: Adds the Event section to the mask.

methods.name: inEventSection
methods.description: Checks if the Event section is included in the mask.

methods.name: addPojoSection
methods.description: Adds the POJO section to the mask.

methods.name: inPojoSection
methods.description: Checks if the POJO section is included.

methods.name: addMessageSection
methods.description: Adds the Message section to the mask.

methods.name: inMessageSection
methods.description: Checks if the Message section is included.
